jess: FYI onboarding hit another snag: async python client doesn't respect REDWOOD_CUSTOM_CA_BUNDLE for Dedicated behind customer proxy. requests path was fine.

mika: that's new — can you paste the exact error?

jess: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate`. Repro snippet:```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
c = AsyncClient(api_key='x', base_url='https://proxy.internal', custom_ca='/etc/ssl/internal.pem')
await c.generate('hi')
```
They also set env var `REDWOOD_CUSTOM_CA_BUNDLE` to the same file with no change.

sam: Async uses aiohttp. We used to build an SSLContext from REDWOOD_CUSTOM_CA_BUNDLE but the AsyncClient refactor introduced a factory that forgot to wire the ca path through.

oliver: also check the retry path. I remember a bug where auth refresh created a new ClientSession without the custom connector, so retries would fail intermittently.

jess: confirmed — reproduces if first request 401s. First call fails, refresh happens, then retry still errors.

mika: plan: (1) make AsyncClient accept `custom_ca` and `ca_bundle_path` kwargs and build one SSLContext used for the lifetime of the client; (2) ensure retry logic reuses the same connector/ssl context; (3) update stub (.pyi) so mypy accepts the kwargs; (4) add small sample in docs and sample-app showing env + docker mount.

sam: workaround for customers today: create a session with a TCPConnector built from a custom SSLContext and assign to client._session. Example:```python
import ssl, aiohttp
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/internal.pem')
conn = aiohttp.TCPConnector(ssl=ctx)
s = aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=conn)
client = AsyncClient(...)
client._session = s
```
Not ideal but unblocks onboarding.

mika: I'll open a small PR with a unit test: start a local test server with a cert signed by a temp CA, load that CA into the client via param and assert handshake succeeds. Also add an integration test for auth-refresh retry to ensure connector isn't swapped.

oliver: add a doc snippet to samples/onboarding/async.md demonstrating `export REDWOOD_CUSTOM_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/ca.pem` and a Dockerfile line to COPY the cert into the image. Note to mention difference from REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE.

ci-bot: build/pytest  pr/5021 running (mika)

jess: thanks — please mark patch release for Dedicated customers once green, this is blocking two pilots. :rocket:
